⚠️ MANDATORY OPERATIONAL SAFETY NOTICE

This application provides engineering reference and educational information compiled from official Indian Railways documents, ACTM, RDSO standards, and other identified technical sources. It is intended to support understanding and reference — not to replace the rules, procedures, or instructions governing actual railway work.

For any actual field activity, the instructions of the competent Railway authority and the responsible supervisor/authorized person must be followed at all times. All applicable statutory safety rules, Permit-to-Work (PTW) requirements, electrical isolation and earthing procedures, power blocks, approved working instructions, local safety practices, and site-specific instructions must be complied with before and during the work.

Do not undertake work solely on the basis of information displayed in this application. Verify the applicable and current instructions, drawings, procedures, and site conditions with the responsible supervisor/competent authority before proceeding.

Where this application contains explanatory, technical, or educational guidance, that information must not be interpreted as authorization to perform work or as a substitute for an approved procedure.

When in doubt, stop the work and seek guidance from the competent supervisor/authority. Safety takes precedence over this reference.
